title: A Hybrid 2D/3D Approach for Neural Differentiation Into Telencephalic Organoids
author: Michele Bertacchi

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following stock solutions and store as indicated: Y‑27632 (ROCKi) 10 mM in DMSO (‑20 °C, ≤6 months); LDN‑193189 5 mM in DMSO (2.46 mL DMSO + 5 mg LDN, ‑20 °C, ≤6 months or ‑80 °C long‑term); SB‑431542 10 mM in DMSO (1.3 mL DMSO + 5 mg SB, ‑20 °C, ≤6 months); XAV‑939 10 mM in DMSO (‑20 °C, ≤6 months); IWR‑1‑endo 3 mM in DMSO (4.065 mL DMSO + 5 mg IWR, ‑20 °C, ≤6 months); BDNF 50 ng/µL in 1× PBS + 0.1 % BSA (‑20 °C, ≤6 months); FGF‑8b 25 ng/µL in 1× PBS + 0.1 % BSA (‑20 °C, ≤6 months); BSA 2 % (w/v) in 1× PBS, filter, aliquot, store ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel coating solution
steps.instruction: Keep all components on ice. Mix 9.95 mL DMEM/F‑12 with 50 µL Matrigel (0.5 % v/v) to obtain 10 mL total; use immediately for coating and discard leftovers.

steps.title: Prepare mTeSR1 complete medium
steps.instruction: Thaw mTeSR1 supplement at 4 °C overnight, invert gently, then add 10 mL supplement to 40 mL mTeSR1 basal medium (80 % basal, 20 % supplement) for 50 mL total; store at 4 °C ≤2 weeks (or aliquot at ‑20 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Medium (NIM)
steps.instruction: For 50 mL, combine: DMEM/F‑12 + GlutaMAX 46 mL (≈92 %); N‑2 1× 500 µL; B‑27 minus vitamin A 1× 1 mL; GlutaMAX 1× 500 µL; NEAA 1× 500 µL; NaPyr 1× 500 µL; Anti/Anti 0.5× 250 µL; β‑mercaptoethanol 50 µM 50 µL (from 50 mM stock); Heparin 2 µg/mL 10 µL (10 mg/mL stock); filter and store 4 °C ≤2 weeks.

steps.title: Add inhibitors to NIM (d0‑d7)
steps.instruction: To freshly prepared NIM, add per 10 mL: LDN‑193189 0.25 µM (0.5 µL of 5 mM stock), SB‑431542 5 µM (5 µL of 10 mM stock), XAV‑939 2 µM (2 µL of 10 mM stock). Protect from light; store at 4 °C ≤1 week. (Alternatively use IWR‑1‑endo 3 µM).

steps.title: Prepare Neural Differentiation Medium (NDM)
steps.instruction: For 50 mL, mix: DMEM/F‑12 + GlutaMAX 23 mL (≈46.2 %); Neurobasal medium 23 mL (≈46.2 %); N‑2 1× 500 µL; GlutaMAX 1× 500 µL; NEAA 1× 500 µL; NaPyr 1× 500 µL; Anti/Anti 0.5× 250 µL; β‑mercaptoethanol 50 µM 50 µL; Heparin 2 µg/mL 10 µL; Insulin 1× 12.5 µL; filter and store 4 °C ≤2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Long‑term Survival Medium (LTSM)
steps.instruction: For ~50 mL, combine: Neurobasal medium 45 mL (≈90 %); N‑2 1× 500 µL; B‑27 minus vitamin A 1× 1 mL; GlutaMAX 1× 500 µL; NEAA 1× 500 µL; NaPyr 1× 500 µL; Anti/Anti 0.5× 250 µL; β‑mercaptoethanol 50 µM 50 µL; Heparin 2 µg/mL 10 µL; FBS 1 % 500 µL; filter, then add Matrigel 0.1 % (50 µL) and BDNF 10 ng/mL (10 µL of 50 ng/µL stock). Keep on ice; store 4 °C ≤2 weeks.

steps.title: Coat 6‑well plate for hiPSC maintenance
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL Matrigel coating solution per well, keep on ice while preparing, then incubate at 37 °C ≥30 min (max overnight) to allow gelation.

steps.title: Thaw and plate hiPSCs (maintenance)
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw one cryovial (1–2 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL freezing medium). Transfer to 10 mL pre‑warmed DMEM/F‑12 to dilute DMSO (optionally add 0.1 % BSA). Centrifuge 288 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in mTeSR1 complete medium containing 10 µM ROCKi, and plate onto the Matrigel‑coated well. After 24 h replace medium with fresh mTeSR1 without ROCKi; thereafter expand per standard hiPSC protocol, using Accutase or Versene for passaging as needed.

steps.title: Coat 24‑well plate for neural induction seeding
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Matrigel coating solution per well (contains 2.5 µL pure Matrigel), keep on ice, then incubate at 37 °C ≥30 min (max overnight).

steps.title: Dissociate and count hiPSCs for seeding
steps.instruction: Wash confluent hiPSCs with pre‑warmed 1× DPBS, add Accutase 5 min at 37 °C (rock gently at min 3), pipette to dissociate, collect cells in 10 mL pre‑warmed DMEM/F‑12, mix, take 15 µL for counting, centrifuge 288 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 5 mL DMEM/F‑12, centrifuge again, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Seed hiPSCs for neural induction
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in mTeSR1 + 10 µM ROCKi, remove coating medium from wells, add 500 µL medium containing 50 000 cells per well (≈25 000 cells/cm²). Rock plate gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. After 24 h replace with mTeSR1 without ROCKi; change medium daily until cells reach ~90 % confluency.

steps.title: Start 2D neural induction (Day 0)
steps.instruction: When cultures are ~90 % confluent, aspirate mTeSR1, wash with 500 µL pre‑warmed DMEM/F‑12, add 500 µL NIM with inhibitors (Recipe 3 + 4) per well, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Change NIM daily; increase volume up to 1 mL/well if medium yellows. If cells detach, add 1 µL Matrigel per 1 mL NIM before each change.

steps.title: Dissociate 2D cultures for 3D aggregation (Day 7)
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 1 mL pre‑warmed 1× DPBS, add 500 µL pre‑warmed Accutase, incubate 7 min at 37 °C (rock after 4 min; extend to ≤15 min if needed), pipette to dissociate, collect in 10 mL DMEM/F‑12, count, centrifuge 288 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 5 mL DMEM/F‑12, centrifuge again, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Form 96‑well aggregates with ROCKi
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in NIM + 10 µM ROCKi, seed 50 µL per well of a 96‑well U‑bottom low‑attachment plate containing 60 000 cells (range 50‑120 000 cells acceptable). Centrifuge plate 200 × g 1 min, incubate overnight 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Embed aggregates in Matrigel “cookies”
steps.instruction: Thaw required Matrigel (e.g., 150 µL for 30 aggregates) on ice. Prepare Parafilm‑lined 100 mm Petri dishes (spray 70 % ethanol, dry). Collect aggregates from 96‑well plate into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, leave a thin liquid film, add Matrigel, keep on ice, cut a 200 µL tip, mix gently, dispense ~10 µL droplets onto Parafilm (one aggregate per droplet). Incubate 20–25 min at 37 °C for solidification.

steps.title: Transfer Matrigel droplets to culture plates
steps.instruction: Prepare a 6‑well plate (orbital shaker) or 12‑well plate (SpinΩ) with 2.5 mL pre‑warmed NIM per well. Add a few µL NIM onto each solidified droplet, pipette up/down to detach, and transfer droplets into the corresponding well. For SpinΩ, place a clean spinning cover and connect to power; set rotation low. For shaker, place plate on orbital shaker at 120 rpm. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 10 medium switch (WNT inhibitor only)
steps.instruction: Remove most medium from each well, add 2.5 mL fresh NIM containing XAV‑939 (or IWR‑1‑endo) at the same concentration as in the inhibitor‑added NIM, but omit SB‑431542 and LDN‑193189. Avoid aspirating the Matrigel cookies; use a cut‑open P1000 tip if needed.

steps.title: Partial medium changes Days 11‑20
steps.instruction: Every 3–4 days, aspirate 1.5 mL medium from each well (cut‑open tip, avoid cookies), replace with 1.5 mL fresh NIM with WNT inhibitor. If medium becomes yellow, split cookies into additional wells to reduce organoid‑to‑medium ratio. Do not exceed 2.5 mL total volume per well.

steps.title: Transition to Neural Differentiation Medium (Days 20‑35)
steps.instruction: Gradually replace NIM with NDM over this period (e.g., 25 % NDM each change) while continuing partial changes every 3–4 days. Monitor colour; split or increase change frequency if yellow.

steps.title: Transition to Long‑term Survival Medium (Days 35‑on)
steps.instruction: Gradually replace NDM with LTSM (e.g., 25 % LTSM each change) from Day 35 onward, refreshing partially every 3–4 days. If organoids enlarge, dissect with ethanol‑sterilized forceps and transfer to fresh wells; use cut‑open tips to avoid damage. Keep total volume ≤2.5 mL per well.

steps.title: Add FGF8 for regional diversity (Day 12‑50)
steps.instruction: Supplement all medium changes (NIM, NDM, LTSM) with recombinant FGF‑8b to a final concentration of 100 ng/mL from Day 12 through Day 50. Adjust as needed for specific hiPSC lines.
